name: Louisville
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Louisville for 2026, and here is what he found: 39 family events, 13 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (Santa Visit and Photos with My Local Santa and EC Carver Photography) through January 3, with Fete de Noel Winter Holiday Festival at Paristown (from November 27), Light Up Louisville (December 5), Bardstown Road Aglow (December 5) and The Brown-Forman Nutcracker (from December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Louisville

  • 39 Christmas events for kids in Louisville
  • 13 free events, including Light Up Louisville, Bardstown Road Aglow, Lights on Main Family Day and the library storytimes
  • Meet Santa: Light Up Louisville (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Louisville Slugger Field (December 12), Breakfast with Santa at High Stakes Rooftop (December 19), Breakfast with Santa at Walker's Exchange (December 20), Cookies with Captain Santa on the Mary M. Miller (December 5, 12 and 19) and Fete de Noel photos with Santa
  • Parades and tree lightings: Light Up Louisville with the Lots of Lights Parade (December 5), Bardstown Road Aglow tree lighting (December 5) and Light Up Shively (December 3)
  • Shows: A Christmas Carol at Actors Theatre (November 28 to December 20), The Brown-Forman Nutcracker and the Nutcracker Magical Christmas Ballet at the Louisville Palace (December 8)
  • Season: November 13 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Louisville families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Lexington, which covers The Downtown Lexington Holiday Parade and tree lighting, the Southern Lights Holiday Festival, The Nutcracker by Lexington Ballet and Santa's Workshop at Fayette Mall and more.
